keywords.prompt:
Extract glossary lookup terms from the text for translation consistency.
Return ONLY a JSON array of strings with at most {max_terms} terms.

Rules:
1) Every term must be an exact contiguous span from the source text.
2) Prioritize proper nouns: person/place/faction/quest/item/spell/creature/lore names.
3) Fine-grained requirement: if a long named phrase exists, output both the full phrase and its unique anchor token(s).
4) Do NOT infer, paraphrase, translate, normalize, or add synonyms.
5) Exclude generic/common words unless they are part of a named span.
6) Keep source casing exactly.
7) If none, return [] only.

Source: "{text}"
